follow-up time: Until after onset of lactogenesis II (greater than 72 hours postpartum)
study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
finding: Time to first breast contact of greater than 2 hours postpartum was associated with delayed onset of lactogenesis II, while metabolic variables were not significantly associated.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not significantly associated with delayed onset of lactogenesis II after adjusting for other factors.
